title: First-coordinate slice decomposition
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube, let $b\in\{ -1,1\}$, and let $x$ be in the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The value of $f$ at the point whose first coordinate is $b$ and whose remaining coordinates are $x$ equals $b$ times the odd part of $f$ at $x$ plus the even part of $f$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube
